blocks.zh: Section 0: Introduction & Regulatory Framework｜導論與法規框架
blocks.en: Section 0: Introduction & Regulatory Framework

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 ICH Q12 的核心目標：建立一套更可預期、更有效率的 上市後 CMC 變更管理框架，並了解其與 Q8/Q9/Q10/Q11 的銜接關係
blocks.en: Understand the core aim of ICH Q12: to establish a more predictable and efficient framework for managing post-approval CMC changes, and how it connects to Q8/Q9/Q10/Q11

blocks.zh: 掌握 Q12 的 適用範圍：涵蓋化學與生物藥品、藥品與器械組合產品，並了解排除項目（藥典修訂引發的變更）
blocks.en: Grasp the scope of Q12: chemical and biological products and drug-device combination products, and the exclusions (changes triggered by pharmacopoeial revisions)

blocks.zh: 能夠列舉並說明 ICH Q12 的 八項監管工具與使能工具（Regulatory Tools and Enablers） 的名稱、章節位置與核心功能
blocks.en: Be able to list and explain the names, section locations and core functions of the eight Regulatory Tools and Enablers in ICH Q12

blocks.zh: 理解 風險分類（Categorisation） 概念：Prior Approval、Notification、PQS 內部管控三層次的區別與邏輯
blocks.en: Understand the concept of Categorisation: the difference and logic behind the three levels of Prior Approval, Notification and PQS-only management

blocks.zh: 了解 Q12 如何透過更多 產品與製程知識 降低上市後監管負擔，並激勵持續改善（continual improvement）
blocks.en: Understand how Q12 uses greater product and process knowledge to reduce the post-approval regulatory burden and to encourage continual improvement

blocks.zh: 1.1 Objectives｜目標
blocks.en: 1.1 Objectives

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy｜從「每次裝修都需市政報批」到「預先核准的房屋設計範圍」
blocks.en: Analogy | From "city approval for every renovation" to "a pre-approved range of house modifications"

blocks.zh: 想像你住的是「監管機構的老舊審批制度」——過去每次翻修房子（CMC 變更）都要重新向政府申請，等三到六個月。Q12 的概念就像是你事先向市政府登記了一份「核准的改裝範圍說明書（PLCM Document）」，並取得了「預先議定的施工許可協議（PACMP）」。只要你的改裝在這個範圍內，就可以自行施工，事後通知即可——甚至某些小改動根本不需要通知。這大大降低了申請行政成本，也讓你更願意持續優化房子（鼓勵持續改善）。
blocks.en: Imagine living under the "old regulatory approval system": every time you renovated your house (a CMC change), you had to apply to the government again and wait three to six months. The Q12 concept is like registering with the city in advance an "approved renovation scope statement (the PLCM Document)" and obtaining a "pre-agreed construction permit agreement (the PACMP)". As long as your renovation stays within that scope, you can build on your own and simply notify afterwards, and some minor changes need no notification at all. This greatly reduces the administrative cost of filing and makes you more willing to keep improving the house (encouraging continual improvement).

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Note｜Q12 不創造「新監管要求」
blocks.en: Key Note | Q12 does not create "new regulatory requirements"

blocks.zh: 原文明確指出：Q12 是 Q8(R2) 和 Q10 Annex 1 中彈性監管方法的延伸與補充，不是新的義務。它是一套工具箱，讓那些有充分知識基礎的公司可以獲得更多彈性。若公司的產品知識不足，同樣的 CMC 變更仍需要標準的 Prior Approval 流程。因此，Q12 其實是對「科學投資」（R&D 階段充分理解製程）的監管獎勵。
blocks.en: The original text states clearly that Q12 extends and complements the flexible regulatory approaches in Q8(R2) and Q10 Annex 1; it is not a new obligation. It is a toolbox that gives companies with a solid knowledge base more flexibility. If a company's product knowledge is insufficient, the same CMC change still has to go through the standard Prior Approval process. Q12 is therefore, in effect, a regulatory reward for "scientific investment" (a thorough understanding of the process during R&D).

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼 Q12 的目標是「商業階段」的 CMC 變更，而不是開發階段？與 Q8/Q11 的分工邏輯是什麼？
blocks.en: Why does Q12 target CMC changes in the "commercial phase" rather than the development phase? How is the work divided between Q12 and Q8/Q11?

blocks.zh: 「增加產品與製程知識可降低監管報批層級」——這個邏輯在 CDMO 的商業模式中有什麼策略意義？
blocks.en: "More product and process knowledge can lower the regulatory reporting category." What strategic meaning does this logic have in a CDMO business model?

blocks.zh: 核心概念：ICH Q 系列的演進脈絡
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Evolution of the ICH Q Series

blocks.zh: 理解 Q12 的第一步，是看清它在整個 ICH Q 系列中的定位：
blocks.en: The first step to understanding Q12 is to see where it sits within the overall ICH Q series:

blocks.zh: Q12 是前四個指南的「應用層」——當你已擁有充分的產品知識（Q8/Q11），懂得風險評估（Q9），並建立了有效的品質系統（Q10），Q12 告訴你如何將這些知識轉化為更順暢的上市後變更流程。
blocks.en: Q12 is the "application layer" of the previous four guidelines: once you have sufficient product knowledge (Q8/Q11), understand risk assessment (Q9) and have established an effective quality system (Q10), Q12 tells you how to turn that knowledge into a smoother post-approval change process.

blocks.zh: 1.2 Scope｜適用範圍
blocks.en: 1.2 Scope

blocks.zh: 適用範圍三要點
blocks.en: Three Key Points on Scope

blocks.zh: 化學藥品（Small Molecules）：最典型的應用場景
blocks.en: Chemical drugs (small molecules): the most typical application scenario

blocks.zh: 生物製品（Biologics）：同樣適用，但生物製品的 EC 識別與變更評估更為複雜
blocks.en: Biological products (biologics): equally applicable, but EC identification and change assessment are more complex for biologics

blocks.zh: 藥品-器械組合產品（Drug-Device Combination Products）：如預填充注射器、自動注射器——只要主要監管路徑是藥品許可，Q12 工具即可適用
blocks.en: Drug-device combination products: such as prefilled syringes and auto-injectors; Q12 tools apply as long as the primary regulatory pathway is a medicinal product authorisation

blocks.zh: 排除項目：藥典修訂引發的變更（例如 USP 更新了某原料藥的限度標準）不在 Q12 範圍內——這類變更屬於「強制合規」，沒有選擇彈性的空間。
blocks.en: Exclusions: changes triggered by pharmacopoeial revisions (for example, USP updating a limit for a drug substance) fall outside Q12; these are "mandatory compliance" changes with no room for choice.

blocks.zh: 重點提示｜Master File 持有人的連帶責任
blocks.en: Key Note | Shared responsibility of the Master File holder

blocks.zh: 腳注 1 揭示了 CDMO 常見的法規場景：若你的原料藥（DS）資訊以 Drug Master File（DMF）形式被多個 MAH 引用，當你的 DS 有重大 CMC 變更時，你有責任通知所有引用方，讓他們評估並向各自的監管機構報告。Q12 工具不改變這個責任鏈，只是提供更有效率的操作框架。
blocks.en: Footnote 1 points to a regulatory scenario common for CDMOs: if your drug substance (DS) information is referenced by several MAHs in the form of a Drug Master File (DMF), then when your DS undergoes a significant CMC change you are responsible for notifying all referencing parties so that they can assess it and report to their respective regulatory authorities. Q12 tools do not change this chain of responsibility; they only provide a more efficient operating framework.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明｜藥典合規變更 vs. Q12 主動變更
blocks.en: Analogy | Pharmacopoeial compliance changes vs. Q12 proactive changes

blocks.zh: 藥典修訂就像「政府改了交通法規，你的車必須換燈泡符合新標準」——這是被動的強制合規，沒有協商空間。Q12 處理的是「你主動想升級引擎以提高燃油效率」——這才是公司自主的改善行動，可以透過科學證據和監管工具來優化審批流程。
blocks.en: A pharmacopoeial revision is like "the government changing the traffic regulations, so your car must swap its bulbs to meet the new standard": it is passive, mandatory compliance with no room for negotiation. Q12 deals with "you decide to upgrade the engine to improve fuel efficiency": a company-driven improvement, where scientific evidence and regulatory tools can be used to streamline the approval process.

blocks.zh: 1.3 ICH Q12 Regulatory Tools and Enablers｜監管工具與使能工具
blocks.en: 1.3 ICH Q12 Regulatory Tools and Enablers

blocks.zh: 工具間的邏輯連結
blocks.en: Logical Links Between the Tools

blocks.zh:
開發階段（Q8/Q9/Q10/Q11）
        ↓ 產生充分的產品與製程知識
        ↓
識別 Established Conditions (ECs)
        ↓ 確定哪些條件「已申報」
        ↓
設計 CMC 變更分類系統（Categorisation）
        ↓ 依風險決定報告層級
        ↓
若需規劃未來變更 → 設計 PACMP（事先議定）
        ↓ 提供可預期的審批路徑
        ↓
彙整至 PLCM Document（集中管理）
        ↓ 供監管機構透明審閱
        ↓
所有 EC 變更都在 PQS 中追蹤管控
        ↓
重複性/頻繁變更 → 採用 Structured Approaches
穩定性數據設計 → 採用 Q12 Stability Approaches
blocks.en:
Development phase (Q8/Q9/Q10/Q11)
        ↓ generates sufficient product and process knowledge
        ↓
Identify Established Conditions (ECs)
        ↓ determine which conditions are "filed"
        ↓
Design the CMC change classification system (Categorisation)
        ↓ set the reporting category according to risk
        ↓
If future changes need planning → design a PACMP (agreed in advance)
        ↓ provides a predictable approval pathway
        ↓
Consolidate in the PLCM Document (centralised management)
        ↓ for transparent regulatory review
        ↓
All EC changes are tracked and controlled in the PQS
        ↓
Repeated/frequent changes → adopt Structured Approaches
Stability data design → adopt Q12 Stability Approaches

blocks.zh: 比喻說明｜Q12 工具箱 vs. 傳統逐案申請
blocks.en: Analogy | The Q12 toolbox vs. traditional case-by-case filing

blocks.zh: 傳統上市後 CMC 變更就像「每次想改菜單，餐廳都要重新向衛生局申請許可，等三個月」。Q12 的工具組合就像：
blocks.en: Traditionally, a post-approval CMC change is like "a restaurant that must reapply to the health department for permission every time it wants to change the menu, then wait three months". The Q12 toolset is more like this:

blocks.zh: ECs：先明確哪些是「政府規範的核心項目」（食材種類、烹調方式），哪些是「廚師自主空間」（調味料比例）
blocks.en: ECs: first define which items are the "core items regulated by the government" (types of ingredients, cooking methods) and which are the "chef's own discretion" (proportion of seasoning)

blocks.zh: PACMP：事先向衛生局提交「未來若更換特定食材，我只需提交這些數據，審批時間為兩週」的協議
blocks.en: PACMP: an agreement submitted to the health department in advance: "if I switch a particular ingredient in the future, I only need to submit this data, and the review time is two weeks"

blocks.zh: PLCM Document：一份清單，整合所有「核心項目」與「未來改動計畫」，讓衛生局一目了然
blocks.en: PLCM Document: a list that consolidates all the "core items" and the "future change plans", so the health department can see everything at a glance

blocks.zh: Categorisation：依據改動風險（食材 vs. 廚具 vs. 服務流程）決定報批層級
blocks.en: Categorisation: the reporting category is decided by the risk of the change (ingredients vs. kitchen equipment vs. service procedures)

blocks.zh: 重點提示｜這些工具是「互補」而非「各自獨立」
blocks.en: Key Note | These tools are "complementary", not "independent"

blocks.zh: Q12 明確指出這八個工具是 complementary（互補的）——它們共同構成一個完整的上市後變更管理生態系統。若只部分採用（例如只用 ECs 但不設計 PACMP），仍可獲益，但效果不如完整應用。對 CDMO 而言，最重要的是先確立 ECs 的識別方法，因為這是後續所有工具的基礎。
blocks.en: Q12 states explicitly that these eight tools are complementary: together they form a complete ecosystem for post-approval change management. Partial adoption (for example, using ECs without designing a PACMP) still brings benefits, but not as much as full application. For a CDMO, the most important step is to establish the method for identifying ECs first, because it is the foundation of all the other tools.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application｜CDMO 的 Q12 導入策略
blocks.en: Practical Application | Q12 implementation strategy for a CDMO

blocks.zh: 作為 CDMO，你為客戶管理多個藥品的商業製造。Q12 的導入應優先考慮：
blocks.en: As a CDMO, you manage commercial manufacturing of multiple drug products for your clients. Q12 implementation should prioritise:

blocks.zh: 高頻率 CMC 變更的產品：如原料藥供應商替換、分析方法升版——這類變更最能從 PACMP 和 Structured Approaches 中受益
blocks.en: Products with frequent CMC changes: such as drug substance supplier replacement and analytical method upgrades; these changes benefit most from PACMPs and Structured Approaches

blocks.zh: 多國上市的產品：不同監管機構的 EC 識別可能不同，PLCM Document 可幫助協調並追蹤各地的報告分類
blocks.en: Products marketed in multiple countries: EC identification may differ between regulatory authorities, and the PLCM Document can help coordinate and track the reporting category in each region

blocks.zh: 生物製品：EC 識別更複雜，但潛在效益也更大——值得投入更多時間建立知識基礎
blocks.en: Biological products: EC identification is more complex, but the potential benefit is also greater, so it is worth investing more time in building the knowledge base

blocks.zh: 請說明 PACMP 與 ECs 的關係：為什麼必須先識別 ECs，才能設計有效的 PACMP？
blocks.en: Explain the relationship between a PACMP and ECs: why must ECs be identified first before an effective PACMP can be designed?

blocks.zh: PLCM Document 與傳統 CTD 申請文件的差異是什麼？它的更新頻率如何管控？
blocks.en: What is the difference between the PLCM Document and a traditional CTD submission? How is its update frequency controlled?

blocks.zh: 為什麼「穩定性數據方法」（Stability Approaches）也被列為 Q12 工具之一？其與 EC 識別有何關聯？
blocks.en: Why are the "Stability Approaches" also listed as one of the Q12 tools? How do they relate to EC identification?

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Q12 的八個工具解析
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Eight Q12 Tools Explained

blocks.zh: Q12 提供了一個完整的「工具箱」，每個工具都有明確定位：
blocks.en: Q12 provides a complete "toolbox", and each tool has a clearly defined role:

blocks.zh: 2. Categorisation of Post-Approval CMC Changes｜上市後 CMC 變更分類
blocks.en: 2. Categorisation of Post-Approval CMC Changes

blocks.zh: 重點提示｜「即時通知」（Immediate Notification）的重要性
blocks.en: Key Note | The importance of "Immediate Notification"

blocks.zh: 原文特別提到 immediate notification——這是為了填補「不需要 Prior Approval，但監管機構希望盡快知悉」的缺口。在實務中，這類機制在某些高度透明的監管環境中（如 EMA 的 Type IA 變更）非常重要。對 CDMO 而言，了解客戶產品在各市場的 immediate notification 要求，是避免違規的關鍵。
blocks.en: The original text specifically mentions immediate notification: it fills the gap for changes that "do not need Prior Approval, but which the regulatory authority wants to know about as soon as possible". In practice, this kind of mechanism is important in some highly transparent regulatory environments (such as EMA Type IA variations). For a CDMO, knowing the immediate notification requirements for your clients' products in each market is key to avoiding non-compliance.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明｜建築許可的三種類型
blocks.en: Analogy | Three types of building permits

blocks.zh: 這就像蓋房子的三種許可：
blocks.en: It is like the three kinds of permits for building a house:

blocks.zh: Prior Approval（建照）：蓋新建築或大幅改建結構，必須先向政府申請、審核通過才能動工
blocks.en: Prior Approval (building permit): to construct a new building or substantially rebuild the structure, you must apply to the government and be approved before work can start

blocks.zh: Notification（施工通知）：換水管或電線等中等規模工程，開工前或完工後向區公所報備即可
blocks.en: Notification (construction notice): for medium-scale work such as replacing water pipes or wiring, it is enough to report to the district office before or after the work

blocks.zh: PQS 內管控（自主維護）：換燈泡、刷油漆——完全自主管理，但房東（查廠員）來的時候可能查看記錄
blocks.en: PQS-only control (self-maintenance): changing a light bulb or repainting is entirely self-managed, though the landlord (the inspector) may check the records when visiting

blocks.zh: 風險越高 → 政府介入越深 → 準備資料越多 → 等待時間越長。這是普世的風險分級邏輯。
blocks.en: The higher the risk, the deeper the government involvement, the more data to prepare, and the longer the wait. This is a universal risk-based grading logic.

blocks.zh: 風險評估邏輯
blocks.en: Risk Assessment Logic

blocks.zh:
報告分類 = f(變更對產品品質的潛在影響)

高潛在影響 → Prior Approval
  + 詳細申請文件
  + 監管機構評審時間（3-12 個月）
  + 可能需要查廠確認

中度潛在影響 → Notification
  + 精簡支撐文件
  + 規定的通知時間窗口（依地區）
  + 較少監管評審資源投入

低潛在影響 → PQS-only Recording
  + 公司內部變更管控文件
  + 查廠時可能被抽查
  + 無需向監管機構主動報告
blocks.en:
Reporting category = f(potential impact of the change on product quality)

High potential impact → Prior Approval
  + Detailed submission dossier
  + Regulatory review time (3-12 months)
  + May require an inspection for confirmation

Moderate potential impact → Notification
  + Streamlined supporting documentation
  + Prescribed notification time window (varies by region)
  + Less regulatory review resource

Low potential impact → PQS-only Recording
  + Internal change control documentation
  + May be sampled during inspections
  + No proactive reporting to regulators required

blocks.zh: 實務應用｜如何「降低」報告分類層級
blocks.en: Practical Application | How to "lower" the reporting category

blocks.zh: Q12 的一個重要機制是：當你積累了更多科學知識，某些原本需要 Prior Approval 的變更，可能降至 Notification 層級。這需要：
blocks.en: An important Q12 mechanism is that as you accumulate more scientific knowledge, some changes that would originally require Prior Approval may drop to the Notification level. This requires:

blocks.zh: 充分的製程理解與 PAT 數據（Q8/Q9）
blocks.en: Thorough process understanding and PAT data (Q8/Q9)

blocks.zh: 清楚識別 Established Conditions（Q12 §3）
blocks.en: Clear identification of Established Conditions (Q12 §3)

blocks.zh: 設計並執行適當的比較性研究
blocks.en: Designing and conducting appropriate comparability studies

blocks.zh: 透過 PACMP（Q12 §4）事先與監管機構議定降類標準
blocks.en: Agreeing the criteria for downgrading the category with the regulatory authority in advance through a PACMP (Q12 §4)

blocks.zh: 這正是「科學投資換取監管效率」的具體體現。
blocks.en: This is exactly what "exchanging scientific investment for regulatory efficiency" looks like in practice.

blocks.zh: 同一類 CMC 變更（例如更換原料藥起始物料供應商）在不同市場（FDA、EMA、PMDA）可能落在不同分類層級——Q12 如何協助跨市場協調這個問題？
blocks.en: The same type of CMC change (for example, changing the supplier of a drug substance starting material) may fall into different categories in different markets (FDA, EMA, PMDA). How does Q12 help harmonise this across markets?

blocks.zh: 「查廠風險」如何影響分類層級的決定？原文提到 "need for regulatory inspection associated with the change may preclude the ability to use a lower category"，請解釋其含義。
blocks.en: How does "inspection risk" affect the decision on the category level? The original text states "need for regulatory inspection associated with the change may preclude the ability to use a lower category"; explain what this means.

blocks.zh: 若公司的 PQS 不夠健全，Q12 的分類體系能否順利運作？為什麼 ICH Q10（PQS）是 Q12 的前提條件？
blocks.en: If a company's PQS is not robust enough, can the Q12 categorisation system work smoothly? Why is ICH Q10 (PQS) a prerequisite for Q12?

blocks.zh: 核心概念：三層分類體系
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Three-Level Categorisation System

blocks.zh: Q12 推薦的分類系統有三個層次，依風險由高至低：
blocks.en: The categorisation system recommended by Q12 has three levels, from highest to lowest risk:

blocks.zh: 注意：Q12 本身不規定哪類具體變更落在哪個層次——這取決於各地區的監管框架（如 EMA、FDA、PMDA 各有其規範）。Q12 鼓勵各成員向這個概念架構「靠攏」。
blocks.en: Note: Q12 itself does not specify which specific changes fall into which level; this depends on each region's regulatory framework (EMA, FDA and PMDA each have their own rules). Q12 encourages members to move toward this conceptual framework.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: Q12 定位：ICH Q 系列的「商業上市後 CMC 變更管理層」，以 Q8/Q9/Q10/Q11 為知識基礎，提供彈性監管工具箱
blocks.en: Q12 positioning: the "commercial post-approval CMC change management layer" of the ICH Q series, built on the knowledge base of Q8/Q9/Q10/Q11 and providing a flexible regulatory toolbox

blocks.zh: 適用範圍：化學與生物藥品、藥品-器械組合產品；藥典修訂引發的合規性變更不在範圍內
blocks.en: Scope: chemical and biological products and drug-device combination products; compliance changes triggered by pharmacopoeial revisions are out of scope

blocks.zh: 八大工具：ECs（既定條件）、PACMP（上市後變更管理計畫）、PLCM Document（產品生命週期管理文件）是三個核心工具；其餘五個（Categorisation、PQS 整合、評估/查廠關係、頻繁變更結構化方法、穩定性方法）為支撐框架
blocks.en: Eight tools: ECs (Established Conditions), PACMP (Post-Approval Change Management Protocol) and the PLCM Document (Product Lifecycle Management document) are the three core tools; the other five (Categorisation, PQS integration, the relationship between assessment and inspection, Structured Approaches for frequent changes, and Stability Approaches) are supporting frameworks

blocks.zh: 三層分類體系：Prior Approval（事前核准）→ Notification（通知）→ PQS-only（內部管控），依風險層級對應不同監管溝通要求
blocks.en: Three-level categorisation: Prior Approval → Notification → PQS-only, with each risk level corresponding to different regulatory communication requirements

blocks.zh: 核心邏輯：科學知識越充分 → 可識別更精確的 ECs → 可設計更有效的 PACMP → 降低 Prior Approval 負擔 → 獲得更大的商業靈活性
blocks.en: Core logic: the more scientific knowledge → more precise ECs can be identified → more effective PACMPs can be designed → lower Prior Approval burden → greater commercial flexibility

blocks.zh: Q12 不是新義務：它是對充分科學投資的監管獎勵，與 Q10 的 PQS 建設互為表裡
blocks.en: Q12 is not a new obligation: it is a regulatory reward for sufficient scientific investment, and goes hand in hand with building the PQS under Q10
